'''Tall Dry Grass''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds two [[Crafting Table]] recipes, a [[Kindling]] recipe (from [[Tall Grass]] or [[Large Fern]]) and an [[Oven]] recipe (from [[Tall Grass]] or [[Large Fern]]). See {{MCW|Tall Dry Grass}} for everything else.
